name: viral-pet-nix
description: Nix — Timeline Dodge. Skill-based viral pet game.

scripts.gauntlet: npm run lint:static && npm run test:ci && npm run test:e2e && echo 'ALL GATES PASSED'
scripts.verify:version: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('./package.json');const read=f=>fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');const expected=p.version;const files=['README.md','DESIGN.md','CHANGELOG.md'];const missing=files.filter(f=>!read(f).includes(expected));if(missing.length){console.error('Version '+expected+' missing from: '+missing.join(', '));process.exit(1)}console.log('Version '+expected+' is documented consistently.')"
